messages:
Maya (growth): Quick sync re: benchmark launch narrative. want one tight hook for blog + webinar that maps latency<>cost.
Eli (design): Suggest a compact hero: curve with 3 pins (hosted/dedicated/private). keep it legible on mobile.
Rohit (analytics): I can generate the curve from our top-5 models across 64/512/2048 tokens. will add a small table for the one-pager.
Hana (product): Core claim: "Predictable latency, controllable spend." But avoid absolute ms numbers without ops sign-off.
Maya (growth): Two short headlines to test in ads: A) "Latency you count on. Costs you control." B) "Trade a few ms for big $ savings."
Eli (design): We'll make GIF for the webinar demo that shows slider shifting focus between latency and cost. simple frames.
Rohit (analytics): I'll prepare A/B gating: landing variant L focuses on latency metrics, variant C on token economics. route leads who check "latency critical" to SDR queue.
InfraBot: Note: routing simulation shows 95p tail reduction ~28% with fallback policy enabled (assumptions attached).
Maya (growth): Owners: blog/webinar copy = Maya, design = Eli, data/dashboard = Rohit, ops notes = Hana. Timeline: draft by Wed, final assets Fri.
Hana (product): I'll review any numerical claims before publish.
Maya (growth): Cool. I'll post a draft link when the outline is ready. Thanks!
